Configuration loading, validation, path expansion, and memfd export for Firedancer.

# Purpose
This file implements configuration loading and validation for Firedancer and Frankendancer. It reads TOML input into an internal POD structure, extracts values into `fd_config_t`, and then fills derived fields such as paths, host name, user and group IDs, cluster name, log settings, and network settings. The code also expands path templates that use `{user}` and `{name}`, checks port range rules, resolves network interfaces and IP addresses, and enforces rules that differ between live clusters, local clusters, and development network namespaces.

The file also defines the main configuration entry points [`fd_config_load_buf`](<#fd_config_load_buf>), [`fd_config_fill`](<#fd_config_fill>), [`fd_config_validate`](<#fd_config_validate>), [`fd_config_load`](<#fd_config_load>), and [`fd_config_to_memfd`](<#fd_config_to_memfd>). Validation uses macros to check required fields, non-zero values, and power-of-two limits, and it rejects invalid combinations such as unsupported network providers or development-only options in live cluster mode. The [`fd_config_to_memfd`](<#fd_config_to_memfd>) function exports a filled configuration into a shared memory file descriptor so other code can map and use the same configuration data.
